prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Edit the supplied cash withdrawal game UI screenshot into a transparent Unity sprite sheet. Preserve the ORIGINAL 852 x 1846 portrait canvas, EXACT original pixel positions, original object dimensions, contours, colors, gloss, texture, shadows and high-quality orchard casual puzzle rendering. This is extraction/restoration, NOT redesign. Remove all orchard scenery to transparency. Remove the large cream/orange outer panel entirely to transparency. Keep only these isolated original controls at their original locations: wooden top title sign (erase its lettering only), the three circular navigation icons, the little pink banknote bundle near Meu saldo, the pale green balance panel (erase R$6,40 only), all five amount cards (erase all R$8/R$10/R$20/R$30/R$50 lettering, remove the green check badge from the first card and place that same original check badge by itself in the otherwise empty area to the right of the bottom-left card at approximately center 607,982), the progress track and its original 80-percent green fill (erase 80% only), and the sage-gray disabled withdraw button (erase Retirar only). All other text, divider, title labels and footers must be removed to transparency. Keep each card's opaque cream or pale mint interior and complete rounded border. The first card must retain the thin vivid green outline and mint interior exactly; other cards retain thin gold/white outline and cream interior. Every outline must be intact, no clipping. No extra ornament, no checkerboard drawn into image. Do not shift, scale or center objects; keep same full portrait canvas as input. Output actual alpha transparency around the isolated controls. The complete sage-gray button silhouette, first selected card, isolated green check, pink cash icon, and rounded progress bar are especially critical.

Edit target is the provided transparent Unity UI sprite sheet. Preserve the EXACT 852x1846 canvas and ALL existing sprite locations, dimensions and style. Two corrections only: (1) Completely clean away stray yellow/white/green fragmented edge pixels and stray noise outside every sprite, producing clean anti-aliased alpha silhouettes, intact contours and soft subtle shadows. In particular the mint/cream card borders and the balance panel have yellow/white residue around them which must be removed. Also remove the tiny noise in the empty area above the progress track. (2) Separate the progress bar into its two usable UI layers: remove the green progress fill from inside the gold progress track at y1283-1376, replacing the ENTIRE interior with the smooth pale beige gray empty-track surface as seen at its right end. Keep the empty gold track at exactly its current position. Put a separate copy of the green fill capsule in the empty space centered x420 at y1190, width587,height65; no text, a full rounded glossy green capsule. Do NOT move anything else. No labels or text. Keep actual alpha transparency. Do not add or alter any detail on existing cards, sage gray button, wooden sign, icons or currency icon.
